CustomField.description: When a new value is added to National account type field on the Asset make sure to update this formula field.
CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK( TEXT( Account.WO_Asset__r.National_Account_Type__c ) ) , null , CASE( TEXT( Account.WO_Asset__r.National_Account_Type__c ) , '82005' , 'Broker' , '82004' , 'Franchise' , '82006' , 'Private Capital Markets' , '82007' , 'Other' , TEXT( Account.WO_Asset__r.National_Account_Type__c ) ) )
CustomField.label: National Account Type
